successors.name: _run_check_raw
successors.reason: Approved CS1 opt-in service forwarding, admission refusal and unavailable assurance composition; default contracts retain their controls. Then analytics-m3-repairs phase 11 (512ed63): reuse of scoped full derivation preparation; results unchanged (that phase's parity gates). Then composition-and-type-induction CT2 (2c25ba4d): optional composition and sources keywords re-derive and verify a composition record before checking the composed bytes, check anchors per source and add the lineage block; with composition=None every path is unchanged. Then rule-check-adoption RC1 (24bb5c9e, dc592a89): an optional rule_ids keyword selects report version 15 and its declared-identity map for a plain version-7 model, and refuses temporal, redaction-policy and reference-population models (check:rule-ids-unsupported) after model load and before population load; with rule_ids=False every path is unchanged. Then rule-check-adoption RC2 (spec 27258a9e, corpus 9130e93d): at wire version 15 only, failing ring verdicts' acyclic extents are computed and forwarded to the payload. Then rule-check-adoption RC3 (spec 0e74261e, corpus 5f860cb4): the optional baseline keyword implies rule_ids, refuses structured-derivation models (check:baseline-unsupported), reads and digests the base once, checks it with the same evaluator, compares, and takes the band from the comparison; the payload carries an uncertified assurance block for that band. After RC3 review findings B2 and B3, the base's warnings are reported with baseline: paths, and a failing base evaluation returns the internal-error payload. Then rule-check-adoption RC4 (spec 509b721d, corpus 938716c9): the optional allow_vacuous keyword implies rule_ids, passes the option to band(), and gives an uncertified assurance block when it accepted a vacuous run.

successors.name: _run_check
successors.reason: Approved CS1 opt-in service forwarding, admission refusal and unavailable assurance composition; default contracts retain their controls. Then approved transition-check-performance TP1: one ModelIndex key per public call through the per-call scope decorator; results unchanged. Then composition-and-type-induction CT2 (2c25ba4d): passes the optional composition and sources keywords through to _run_check_raw; the default (None) is unchanged. Then rule-check-adoption RC1 (24bb5c9e, dc592a89): passes the optional rule_ids keyword through to _run_check_raw and refuses it with admission or compiled operations; the default (False) is unchanged. Then rule-check-adoption RC3 (spec 0e74261e, corpus 5f860cb4): forwards the optional baseline keyword, which like rule_ids excludes admission and compiled operations. Then rule-check-adoption RC4 (spec 509b721d, corpus 938716c9): forwards the optional allow_vacuous keyword, which like rule_ids excludes admission and compiled operations.

successors.name: _cmd_check
successors.reason: Approved CS1 single/batch CLI opt-in forwarding. Then composition-and-type-induction CT2 (2c25ba4d): the --composition and --sources options are validated and forwarded to the check service; without them the handler is unchanged. Then rule-check-adoption RC1 (24bb5c9e, dc592a89): the --rule-ids option is forwarded to the check service and text output reads the declared addresses back from a version-15 payload; without it the handler is unchanged. Then rule-check-adoption RC3 (spec 0e74261e, corpus 5f860cb4): forwards --baseline and prints the BASELINE summary after the report. Then rule-check-adoption RC4 (spec 509b721d, corpus 938716c9): forwards --allow-vacuous and prints its closing line after the report. Then report-output-fidelity ROF1 (issue 112, owner-approved 2026-11-07): the declaration-bearing (redaction or temporal) text route calls _print_projected_check_text, which prints check verdict lines from the projected payload instead of its JSON. Then report-output-fidelity ROF2 (issue 112, owner-approved 2026-11-07): --admission on a projected route renders the check layout through _print_projected_check_text instead of the shared projected-JSON text.
